newsitem.title: CANADA: Anvil Range sees Faro statement today.
newsitem.headline: Anvil Range sees Faro statement today.

text.p: Anvil Range Mining Corp said on Monday that it expects to make an announcement today on the fate of its Faro lead-zinc mine in the Yukon.
A spokeswoman for Anvil said the mood was optimistic over the mine and that the announcement was imminent.
"Your guess is as good as mine on exactly what it's going to say, but I would think that the mood is optimistic."

The mine was temporarily shut down last December because of lower than expected base metal prices, a strong Canadian dollar and delays in stripping the mine. The mill operation was suspended earlier this year.
Anvil Range shares were untraded on the day, but closed on Friday at C$2.95 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
